svg.title: Floodhall Passage — Lanternfish glyph gallery
svg.desc: The dry gallery steps down alongside submerged door glyphs. Observation desks, service ladders and lamp platforms support the light-following activity without requiring diving. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.
svg.text: Shared access · None hostile; aid creature 26–30

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: The dry gallery steps down alongside submerged door glyphs. Observation desks, service
ladders and lamp platforms support the light-following activity without requiring diving.
7 raised landings · 2 stairs · 3 ropes · 2 ladders · 24 props
